Rina: Morning team — quick sync to lock SI onboarding steps for the field cohort. Need final kit BOM, regional shipping cutoffs, and cert windows by EOD Friday.

Owen: For shipping: separate manifests for APAC vs EU/NA; APAC needs IEC adapters and added export docs. I'll compile addresses once partners confirm.

Samir: Certification plan: 48hr regional windows + optional live proctor slots. Auto-grade MC, manual review for config exercise. Pass >=75%. Propose screencast of bringup as evidence.

Jules: Marketing asks for partner blurbs + logo consent 7 days before announce. Legal: any contract clauses we should know about?

legal: If partners requested pre-announce review, send drafts to legal@redwood with subject "SI Onboard Copy Review" at least 7 days prior. Also include any trademark usage guidelines.

Rina: Kit BOM draft: RDW-SI-TRAY-v1, USB-image-signed, EU/US/APAC adapter (region-specific), quickstart card, return label. Include ECCN 5D002 on Intl manifests.

Owen: Carrier prefs: DHL APAC, UPS EU/NA. Need PO & cost center before release. I'll request procurement PO RDW-SI-3276 today.

Samir: Grading: we'll run a 1hr calibration session for graders before the first window. Also 10% manual spot-check after issuance. If screencast fails, allow one resubmit within 7 days.

ops-bot: [automation] pack-job queued (job_id=pack-3276) — est. pickup: 2026-11-02.

Jules: I'll gather marketing assets and push the creative brief. Deadline for logos: Oct 25. If partners want co-branding variations, expect +48h.

Rina: Action items:
- Owen: finalize manifests + PO (due Thu EOD).
- Samir: publish rubric + schedule grader calibration (due Wed).
- Jules: collect blurbs + logos, loop legal if embargo (due Fri).
- Legal: standby for review (on receipt).

Owen: Noted. One blocker: a partner in LATAM needs 110V adapter and special customs code. I'll surface exceptions here when found.

Samir: I'll upload the small `lab-provision` snippet to the training repo and share the walkthrough recording link after the dry run.

Rina: Ok closing this thread — post exceptions in-channel. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
